FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'There is a cake and there are balloons.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.
   B. C'est le premier janvier.
   C. Tu as quel âge ?
   D. Joyeux anniversaire !

2. How do you say 'My name is Amina.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Et toi ?
   B. Ça s'écrit comment ?
   C. Je m'appelle Amina.
   D. Ça va ?

3. What does 'C'est une table.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. It is a table.
   B. There is a sofa in the living room.
   C. In the kitchen, there is a fridge.
   D. The bag is in the bedroom.

4. How do you say 'the tomato' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le pain
   B. les frites
   C. la tomate
   D. la santé

5. What does 'Tournez' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. You are welcome
   B. Go
   C. Excuse me
   D. Turn

6. What does 'Le tapis est sous la table.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Turn right.
   B. The rug is under the table.
   C. The fridge is in the kitchen.
   D. Turn left.

7. What does 'le ballon' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the fridge
   B. the sofa
   C. the cat
   D. the ball

8. How do you say 'The ball is behind the door.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est une table.
   B. Le ballon est derrière la porte.
   C. Dans la cuisine, il y a un frigo.
   D. Mets le livre sur la table.

9. Which month is 'avril'? (1 mark)
   A. January
   B. May
   C. August
   D. April

10. Read: Amina: Bonjour, Kamau ! Kamau: Salut, Amina ! Ça va ? Amina: Oui, ça va bien, merci. Question: Who says Ça va ? (1 mark)
   A. Kamau
   B. the teacher
   C. Amina
   D. nobody

11. Read: Je m'appelle Amina. J'ai un frère et une sœur. Mon frère s'appelle Kamau. Ma sœur s'appelle Njeri. Question: What is the brother called? (1 mark)
   A. Amina
   B. Njeri
   C. Kamau
   D. Grace

12. Which little word goes with 'canapé' (the sofa)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. l'
   C. les
   D. la

13. How do you say 'Hello, Amina!' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Ça s'écrit comment ?
   B. Au revoir, Monsieur.
   C. Bonjour, Amina !
   D. Ça va bien, merci.

14. What does 'le père' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the grandfather
   B. the girl
   C. the father
   D. the family

15. How do you say 'Today it is raining.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Aujourd'hui, il pleut.
   B. Il y a du vent.
   C. Je reste dans la maison.
   D. Demain, il fait beau.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into French: 'What is the weather like?' (3 marks) (3 marks)

17. List the members of a nuclear family in French with le or la. Give at least five. (5 marks) (5 marks)

18. Translate into English: 'La télé est dans le salon.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

19. Translate into English: 'Tournez à droite.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

20. Translate into English: 'Merci beaucoup !' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.
   There is a cake and there are balloons. in French is Il y a un gâteau et des ballons.

2. C — Je m'appelle Amina.
   My name is Amina. in French is Je m'appelle Amina..

3. A — It is a table.
   C'est une table. means It is a table.

4. C — la tomate
   the tomato in French is la tomate.

5. D — Turn
   Tournez means Turn.

6. B — The rug is under the table.
   Le tapis est sous la table. means The rug is under the table.

7. D — the ball
   le ballon means the ball.

8. B — Le ballon est derrière la porte.
   The ball is behind the door. in French is Le ballon est derrière la porte.

9. D — April
   avril means April.

10. A — Kamau
   Kamau asks Ça va ? in his second line.

11. C — Kamau
   Mon frère s'appelle Kamau.

12. A — le
   canapé is masculine, so we say le canapé.

13. C — Bonjour, Amina !
   Hello, Amina! in French is Bonjour, Amina !

14. C — the father
   le père means the father.

15. A — Aujourd'hui, il pleut.
   Today it is raining. in French is Aujourd'hui, il pleut.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Quel temps fait-il ?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 3 marks in total.

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: le père, la mère, le frère, la sœur, le bébé (also l'enfant, le grand-père, la grand-mère)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its le or la.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: The TV is in the living room.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Turn right.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Thank you very much!
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.
